## Caveat

* [MadGraph pixi tasks regenerate any missing run directory](extract-diagrams-reruns-madgraph-on-missing-dir.md) - Tasks that depend on build-diagrams silently re-run MadGraph for every card whose output directory is missing, unless invoked with --skip-deps.
* [The fermion-line reversal sign does not depend on vertex content](fermion-line-sign-ignores-vertex-content.md) - Note 35's rule gating the per-propagator −1 on a line's Dirac-matrix content was reverted on 2026-10-05; every uncrossed line takes one −1 per internal propagator.
* [Partonic σ is not comparable across some refdata boundaries](refdata-sigma-comparability.md) - A partonic σ from refdata-2 is not comparable to refdata-3 and later (αs 0.130 vs 0.118), nor are the four re-carded runs across refdata-4 → refdata-5.

## Measurement

* [Run-to-run timing spread on the M3 Max performance host](m3-max-host-timing-noise.md) - The performance layer's run-to-run spread is 0.8% median / 3.4% worst on rows above 1 s, so sub-1% claims are not measurable there; a noisy host costs ~12.7%.
